kitty2.speaker: Kitty
kitty2.text: I can't believe I actually made it across...

kitty3.speaker: Kitty
kitty3.text: Now I just need to find that super-duper rare flower to prove that I'm not a scaredy-cat!

kitty1.speaker: Kitty
kitty1.text: The log is broken, I can't go back!

kitty1.speaker: Kitty
kitty1.text: Gulp... It's so high... Where is mom? I wanna go home...

crow1.speaker: The Crow
crow1.text: Wake up, Kitty, are you okay?

crow4.speaker: The Crow
crow4.text: You've found my second monocle. Now I can CLEARLY see how brave you are!

kitty2.speaker: Kitty
kitty2.text: Ughhhh, how did I get here? The last thing I remember is being on top of the tree and everything was spinning...

crow5.speaker: The Crow
crow5.text: Kitty, I'm a crow. I brought you down.

kitty3.speaker: Kitty
kitty3.text: Oh no!!! That means... I failed...

kitty4.speaker: Kitty
kitty4.text: I'll never get that stupid flower now!!

crow8.speaker: The Crow
crow8.text: Why do you think you failed, Kitty?

kitty6.speaker: Kitty
kitty6.text: What do you mean? I fainted and you had to bring me down!!

kitty6_1.speaker: Kitty
kitty6_1.text: I'm clearly not brave enough to get the super-duper rare flower...

crow9.speaker: The Crow
crow9.text: But you DID cross the river, even though it was super dark and scary for you.

crow10.speaker: The Crow
crow10.text: And you DID go to that scary labyrinth, even though you're afraid of the dark.

crow11.speaker: The Crow
crow11.text: And you DID climb that tree despite your fear of heights!!!

crow12.speaker: The Crow
crow12.text: It doesn't matter to me that you failed in the end.

crow13.speaker: The Crow
crow13.text: You faced your fears with a bravery I haven't seen in any other kitten!

crow14.speaker: The Crow
crow14.text: You aren't afraid to challenge yourself, and you aren't afraid of change.

crow15.speaker: The Crow
crow15.text: I'm proud of you, Kitty. You deserve the... 'super-duper rare flower'.

kitty9_2.speaker: Kitty
kitty9_2.text: That's the kindest thing anyone has ever said to me!!!

crow17.speaker: The Crow
crow17.text: But don't get ahead of yourself just yet. You still have some challenges to overcome.

kitty1.speaker: Kitty
kitty1.text: Before I go, can I ask you a question?

kitty2.speaker: Kitty
kitty2.text: Why do you need... two monocles?

kitty4.speaker: Kitty
kitty4.text: Why don't you wear glasses then?

caw2.speaker: The Crow
caw2.text: How... unexpected... you don't seem old enough to be here.

kitty1.speaker: Kitty
kitty1.text: Uhm... Mr. Crow, may I ask if you happen to know where a super-duper rare flower may be?

caw5.speaker: The Crow
caw5.text: But how do I know if you are brave enough to get it? Only the brave ones are allowed into the forest!

caw7.speaker: The Crow
caw7.text: Find my monocle to prove that you are worthy of venturing further.

kitty3.speaker: Kitty
kitty3.text: Nuh uh. I am not scared!

caw1.speaker: The Crow
caw1.text: Have you found my monocle yet?

caw2.speaker: The Crow
caw2.text: You found ONE of my monocles!!!

caw3.speaker: The Crow
caw3.text: Have you found the second one?

caw5.speaker: The Crow
caw5.text: Now scurry off and find my other monocle!

caw1.speaker: The Crow
caw1.text: Have you found my other monocle?

caw1.speaker: The Crow
caw1.text: Have you found my other monocle?

caw4.speaker: The Crow
caw4.text: Thanks! The flower should be right there!

caw1.speaker: The Crow
caw1.text: Thanks for helping me find my monocles!

kitty1.speaker: Kitty
kitty1.text: Finally! I got the super duper rare flower!

kitty2.speaker: Kitty
kitty2.text: Oh No! When did it get so dark? I need to get home.

caw1.speaker: Kitty
caw1.text: I have to get the flower before I go back!

caw1.speaker: Kitty
caw1.text: I shouldn't go further, I could get lost!

caw1.speaker: Kitty
caw1.text: Hmm... This paper contains directions to a festival deeper in the forest.

caw2.speaker: Kitty
caw2.text: The log is broken... I should go to the festival and ask around for other directions to the city.
